meta.name: contract-review
meta.description: Contract review skill that adds comment-based issue annotations without changing original text. Enforces a three-layer review (basic, business, legal), writes structured comments (issue type, risk reason, revision suggestion) with risk level encoded via reviewer name, and generates a contract summary, consolidated opinion, and Mermaid business flowchart (with rendered image). Output language must follow the contract’s language.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查合同并添加结构化批注与摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速审查合同条款并生成风险摘要
copy.tagline_en: Review contracts with structured annotations and summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly review contract clauses and generate risk summaries

howto.what: Claude 会不改动合同原文，只在文档里添加评论式批注，按规定做基础、商业、法律三层审查，并生成合同摘要、综合审核意见和业务流程图（含图片）。输出语言与合同一致。
howto.when: 当用户提交 .docx 合同文件并请求审查合同时触发；技能会先解包文件再开始处理。

say.text: 帮我审查这份合同，按三层标准加批注并出报告。
say.note: 启动三层审查并生成带批注的docx和报告。

say.text: 审核这个docx合同，重点标出风险条款和修改建议。
say.note: 先解包docx，按基础、商业、法律三层加批注。

say.text: 请按三层标准审查这份合同，输出摘要、意见和流程图。
say.note: 会生成四份交付文件，语言跟随合同。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews the contract (.docx) by adding comments only, leaving the original text untouched. It runs a three-layer review (basic, business, legal) and generates a summary, opinion, and Mermaid flowchart (rendered image). Output language follows the contract.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user submits a .docx contract file and asks for contract review; the skill unpacks the file before processing.

say_en.text: Review this contract with the three-layer standard and comment on issues.
say_en.note: Starts review and returns annotated docx plus reports.

say_en.text: Review this docx contract, flag risk clauses and suggest revisions.
say_en.note: Unpacks docx and adds structured comments layer by layer.

say_en.text: Do a three-layer review of this contract and output summary, opinion, and flowchart.
say_en.note: Generates four deliverables in the contract's language.
